verdict.rationale: Stripe documents payouts of the available balance to a bank account, Dashboard tracking of payouts and their expected deposit dates, and financial report runs (balance, payouts, activity) that produce downloadable CSVs. That gives finance-ops a real starting point for matching settlements to deposits. However, no evidence shows a payout-level reconciliation report that itemizes the fees, refunds and chargebacks inside each bank deposit, and the report access is documented mainly through the AI/MCP analytics path. Missing for 10: documented per-payout itemized reconciliation covering fees, refunds and chargebacks, evidence that report contents break down these components, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks
